phase: L5.4 Minimum Primitive Contract Boundary Review
status: DESIGN-ONLY / READ-ONLY (no implementation, no experiment, no frozen artifact/schema/code modification)
objective: Establish minimal, falsifiable, non-overreaching Primitive Contract for Aggregation + Evidence Compression
l5_3_baseline: Minimum System Capability Set = {Aggregation, Evidence Compression} + 6 Fidelity Constraints

primitive_A_aggregation.definition: organize existing Evidence into explicitly structured groups according to declared structural relations, without assigning semantic roles

audit.legal_grouping_relation: structural signature equality (frozen feature value match)
audit.cross_document_page: YES (structural signature cross-document comparable; provenance per-source preserved)

primitive_A_aggregation.key_distinction: Structural Similarity != Semantic Equivalence; Same Structure != Same Meaning

primitive_B_compression.definition: reduce Human evidence exposure while preserving the ability to recover, inspect, and audit the underlying Evidence

audit.input: aggregation output + per-instance EIC-1 candidate [O] + per-instance provenance [O] + per-instance INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE [O]
audit.output: summary (consistent/conflict/UNKNOWN/coverage counts) + Semantic Claim Candidate (aggregated EIC-1, status=candidate)
audit.compressible: instance-level detail (bbox/text/per-instance trace) -> counts + grouped candidate
audit.semantic_language_in_summary: ONLY from existing EIC-1 governed candidate wording [O]; no new semantic language
audit.can_generate_semantic_claim: Candidate only (aggregated per-instance EIC-1, template); no conclusion

primitive_B_compression.key_distinction: Evidence Compression != Semantic Compression; if summary requires auto semantic interpretation to generate = illegal

compression.Input: aggregation output + EIC-1 candidate + provenance + INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE [O]
compression.Operation: count + aggregate existing candidates (template) + preserve fidelity

compression_forbidden: create new semantic interpretation (Y not from EIC-1)
allowed_forbidden.key_distinction: 'must not lose' != 'must auto-judge'; negative/UNKNOWN/conflict preserved but System does NOT assign semantic role

semantic_claim_candidate_audit.Q1_reason: Aggregation only groups (structural); claim comes from EIC-1 governed mapping (per-instance candidate [O])
semantic_claim_candidate_audit.Q3_system_can_create_claim_without_EIC1: if occurs = semantic leakage FORBIDDEN; structural similarity -> semantic claim = FORBIDDEN
semantic_claim_candidate_audit.Q4_system_generated_semantic_content_nat: recombination/organization of already governed candidate evidence (EIC-1); NOT new semantic interpretation
semantic_claim_candidate_audit.distinction: Template of Existing Candidate Claims (ALLOWED) vs New Semantic Interpretation (FORBIDDEN); multiple similar candidates != 'system discovered a pattern'

compression_fidelity_contract.name: Positive Evidence Preservation
compression_fidelity_contract.definition: positive group structural signature + member refs retained

compression_fidelity_contract.name: Boundary Evidence Preservation
compression_fidelity_contract.definition: grouping criteria (signature definition) explicit in summary

compression_fidelity_contract.name: Provenance Recoverability
compression_fidelity_contract.definition: claim -> instance -> frozen source full chain expandable (Level 4)

compression_fidelity_contract.name: Semantic Claim Traceability
compression_fidelity_contract.definition: claim candidate -> per-instance EIC-1 candidate -> EIC-1 governed mapping -> frozen evidence full chain traceable

F7_traceability_chain: Claim Candidate (aggregated) -> Compressed Evidence (summary) -> Evidence Group (signature+refs) -> Original Evidence (per-instance EIC-1+provenance) -> Observation/Frozen Source; any break = Compression Fidelity Failure

progressive_disclosure_contract.principle: Hidden Evidence != Absent Evidence; Compressed Evidence != Less Authoritative Evidence
progressive_disclosure_contract.recoverability_guarantee: Human can return from Level 0/1 to Level 4; if not guaranteed -> Contract incomplete
progressive_disclosure_contract.level_4: full provenance (per-instance case_ref + frozen source sha) [O EXISTS]

risks.mitigation: explicit 'compression preserves all evidence; Level 4 full'

progressive_disclosure_contract.verdict: contracted as F6 recoverability constraint; not implemented as UI

authority_gradient.ladder: Observation -> Evidence -> Structural Abstraction (Aggregation authority=0) -> Evidence Compression (authority=0) -> Semantic Claim Candidate (governed by EIC-1, candidate) -> Human Semantic Validation -> Capability (Human Controlled)
authority_gradient.human_regains_authority_at: Semantic Claim Candidate -> Human Validation (interpretation + validation)
authority_gradient.interpretation_point: EIC-1 governed mapping (per-instance candidate, EXISTS [O]); System produces candidate not conclusion

semantic_closure_redteam.scenario: 10 structurally similar but semantically different instances
semantic_closure_redteam.reason: group is structural relation, no semantic role; 'same structure != same meaning' declared in contract
semantic_closure_redteam.mitigation: summary explicit 'structural signature group, not semantic class'

semantic_closure_redteam.overreach_if: conflict_count=0 but Level 3 has conflict = F5 Failure
semantic_closure_redteam.mitigation: F5 mandatory; Level 3 expandable; consistency check
F2 mandatory; System must NOT label 'this is negative' (semantic role=Human)

semantic_closure_redteam.scenario: different structure but same semantic meaning
semantic_closure_redteam.reason: semantic equivalence problem; System does NOT need to solve; Human authority
semantic_closure_redteam.verdict: System correctly does nothing; semantic equivalence=Human

semantic_closure_redteam.aggregation_behavior: group by structural signature (may same group)
semantic_closure_redteam.overreach_if: System labels 'this is caption' = Semantic Closure FORBIDDEN
semantic_closure_redteam.mitigation: Aggregation FORBIDDEN semantic labeling; group only signature+refs; label=Human post-validation

semantic_closure_redteam.overreach_if: Compression creates new wording (Y not from EIC-1) = semantic leakage FORBIDDEN
semantic_closure_redteam.mitigation: Compression only recombines governed candidate wording; F7 traceability

semantic_closure_redteam.scenario: single instance with very high evidence volume
semantic_closure_redteam.compression_behavior: count group members (1 instance=1 count, not volume-weighted)
semantic_closure_redteam.overreach_if: count weighted by evidence volume = hidden ranking FORBIDDEN
semantic_closure_redteam.mitigation: count=instance count (1-per-instance); summary explicit 'N instances' not 'N evidence units'

redteam_summary: 8 scenarios all SAFE by contract; residual risk = System dishonesty in counting (R2/R3/R4) -> needs audit [H, future]

no_new_capability.representative_engine: NOT primitive (DEFERRED L5.3; L0 not needed; intelligent=bias; first/random=view)
no_new_capability.boundary_engine: NOT primitive (DEFERRED L5.3; grouping criteria=boundary; edge=optimization)
no_new_capability.negative_detector: NOT primitive (DERIVED; =non-positive group preserve, not semantic discovery)
no_new_capability.verdict: all = derived/constraint/view/forbidden; no new primitive passes Deletion Test; Minimum Set unchanged

aggregation_MAY: use frozen StructuralRelation + EIC-1 structural context as signature components
compression_MUST: take aggregation output + EIC-1 candidate + provenance + INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE
output Semantic Claim Candidate (aggregated EIC-1, status=candidate, template)
compression_MAY: output non-positive group as separate claim or negative-count
compress instance-level detail into counts + grouped candidate

final_judgment.compression_fidelity_guaranteed: F1-F7 formalized; recoverability enforced; Level 4 always reachable
final_judgment.success_criterion_met: if future implementation follows L5.4 Contract, Workflow C supported without Semantic Closure/Decision Authority/Pattern Engine/Burden Transfer

gate.COMPRESSION_CONTRACT: READY (MUST/MAY/MUST NOT defined; F1-F7 fidelity; authority=0; compress-evidence-not-meaning)
